newsitem.title: USA: Dundee Bancorp chairman raises stake.
newsitem.headline: Dundee Bancorp chairman raises stake.

text.p: Ned Goodman, chairman, president and chief executive officer of Dundee Bancorp, said Wednesday he acquired 65,262 common shares of the company for $1,566,288 in a private transaction on Jan. 16.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Goodman said he owns 58.6 percent, or 679,270 shares, of the Toronto-based company's outstanding common shares.
Goodman also owns 4.1 percent, or 993,174 Class A shares, of the company, including 384,000 Class A shares which may be acquired upon the exercise of stock options, the filing said.
Goodman holds the common and Class A shares for investment purposes.
